title: AAWSAP to AATIP to Elizondo to New York Times chain
summary: Merrick tells of AAWSAP to AATIP to Elizondo to New York Times chain, about 2007-2017 at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: There's a chain you can draw a direct link OSAP to ATIP to to Lu Alzano to New York Times.

plain: On Jesse Michels's podcast, a guest named Merrick says there is a direct chain that runs from AAWSAP, a Pentagon-funded study of unexplained phenomena that began around 2007, to AATIP, a small Pentagon office that studied unexplained aerial reports, then to a man named Lou Elizondo, and finally to the New York Times newspaper, which reported on it in 2017. In his telling, this chain is the path by which the government's quiet interest in UFOs reached the public.
